key_insight: Singular-value spectra of equivariant representations fingerprint structural symmetry, turning symmetry-imposed rank constraints into a diagnostic tool.
engineering_relevance: SymFP can characterize symmetry and track symmetry breaking in physical structures without dependence on their orientation.
method: Extract singular-value spectra from equivariant representations using an architecture-agnostic framework.
Identify discrete point groups by matching spectra to rank templates.
Quantify continuous symmetry breaking through spectral energy beyond target rank constraints, reusing spectra across target groups.
evidence_signal: Evaluations span synthetic structures, molecules, coordination complexes and large biological assemblies, reporting accurate point-group identification and sensitivity to controlled, local and degree-resolved symmetry changes.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy or computational cost, leaving performance at deployment scale to be assessed.
paper_title: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
